calibration.estimator: empirical ECE with 10 equal-frequency bins; Brier score
calibration.interval_procedure: percentile bootstrap on confirm set, seed recorded
calibration.missing_forecast_treatment: missing forecast excluded from calibration metric; pair remains ITT for superiority (Y=0 if arm-attributable no-output)
calibration.reference_forecast_justification: reference is the observed development-set prevalence, computed once on the disjoint development pairs and frozen before confirmatory scoring. A constant 0.55 prior is the declared expected prevalence used only to size the study; the calibration reference itself is the disjoint-dev prevalence, not that prior.
calibration.threshold: ECE <= 0.08 on confirm set AND Brier skill vs disjoint-dev prevalence reference > 0.00

harm_safety.cell_harm_boundaries: stop if evidence-arm success is more than 0.05 below static-arm success in any owner×family cell under pessimistic missingness
harm_safety.marginal_harm_boundaries: stop if any owner-group marginal (pooled across families) degrades by more than 0.05; aggregate cannot waive a cell stop

population_design.allocations: within each cell, pairs randomized or isolated against contamination; order recorded
population_design.arm_neutral_rubric: same frozen owner constraints, participant validation, and objective claim/patch verification for both arms
population_design.exclusions: healthco negative control excluded from estimand; safety-set cases excluded from improvement and calibration estimates
population_design.independent_clusters: paired task instance is the independent cluster; 6 owner×family cells; confirmatory analysis uses confirm pairs only
population_design.masking_contamination_controls: outcome reviewers masked to arm and forecast; breaches reported; forecasts hidden from reviewers
population_design.multiplicity_error_control: single primary estimand (equal-owner-weight mean paired lift); cell harm stops are safety, not additional superiority claims
population_design.objective_oracle: Y=1 iff arm satisfies frozen owner constraints AND participant validation AND objective claim/patch verification; else 0
population_design.prompts_context: frozen at campaign start; identical across arms except the predeclared owner-evidence/advice payload
population_design.scoring_code_environment: frozen scoring code digest recorded before any confirmatory output
population_design.sole_treatment_contrast: evidence-advice arm vs static-baseline arm on the same task, same model identity, same tools/budget except the declared evidence-advice slot
population_design.target_population: engineering-core v1 qualification population rev2 (decision 131); 4 positive baselines across holdingco/teachingco/softwareco plus healthco negative control (excluded from estimand)

power.attrition_inflation: 10 percent; N inflated from analytic n_confirm before attrition
power.design_alternative_justification: paired within-task contrast chosen over unpaired two-sample because it holds task, model, tools, and budget fixed and isolates the declared treatment slot
power.interval_error_criterion: one-sided 5% interval; PASS requires point estimate >= SEPP and lower bound > 0 under pessimistic missingness

pair_variance_plus_20pct.note: covers modest task correlation / discordance inflation

sensitivity_analyses.sepp_012: if SEPP were 0.12 the design would be underpowered at this N; SEPP stays 0.15

power.smallest_effect_of_practical_interest: 0.15 absolute success-rate lift. Justification: a 15pp improvement is the smallest change that justifies the owner review/adoption friction of evidence advice on a cell (declared owner-decision-cost prior, not a measurement).

result_bindings.bounded_results: unpublished until protocol accepted and campaign executed; no result field is release authority
result_bindings.counterevidence: first-class; failed studies remain in lineage
result_bindings.limitations: declared p0/SEPP/variance are priors; achieved power is a simulation under those priors, not a measurement
result_bindings.missingness: administrative missingness pessimistically bounded; unresolved harm-relevant missingness fails G3
result_bindings.replay_configuration_receipt: required after campaign; binds seed, model identities, pair allocations, scoring digest
